guidance: We have deployed 3,000 plus TEUs dry containers, which is equivalent to 2,000 dry container boxes, and we expect the division to ramp up over, H2 FY27.
With a strong first half, multiple new growth levels now in place, and promoter capital committed, we remain confident of delivering sustainable and profitable growth in FY27 and beyond.
capex: Our NVOCC business accounted for 8.2% of revenue, highlighting the gradual expansion of our container-led operations.
EBITDA margin improved to 12.2% compared to 11.3% in H1 FY26 representing an expansion of 90 basis points.
risks: The statements are not the guarantees of future performance and involve risk and uncertainties.
Despite these challenges, global air cargo demand remains resilient, with volume growing 7.7% year-on-year in September 2026, as per IATA.
focus: We are encouraged by this performance and remain focused on sustaining this growth momentum in the coming future.
In our last call, we had spoken about our plans to diversify into dry container logistics, and I am pleased to share that this is now operational together with our ISO tank container fleet.
Our consistent focus on service quality, compliance, and timely execution has translated into high-repeat business.
